title: Solutions Architect Intern, AWSI - 2027
description:
Description

Amazon internships are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work onsite Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week for 12 consecutive weeks typically between 8am-5pm.

Are you a motivated technologist with a unique blend of curiosity, technical chops, and strong interpersonal skills? Do you want to help us build new things and evangelize AWS with customers? Do you enjoy being a guiding force, enabling customers to use best practices and design their applications and platforms for the cloud? As a Solutions Architect Intern, you will receive AWS technical training, immerse yourself in cloud computing concepts, and have the opportunity to impact customers in a variety of industries.

The Solutions Architect (SA) organization is a diverse team that focuses on helping customers build infrastructures and applications at scale using AWS solutions. We are passionate about technology and relish the chances to dive deep and wide within the AWS platform in our quest to delight customers.

If this sounds exciting to you - come build the future with us!

Program Overview

Our program offers a 3-month mentorship where you will:

Learn how to architect solutions on the AWS Cloud
Develop skills to lead customer engagements as a Solutions Architect
Work alongside experienced professionals who will guide your development

Location Details: Dallas, TX or Seattle, WA

Start Date details: This is a cohort-based program where everyone is required to start on the same day. Start dates are tentatively set to occur June 21st and May 24th.

Key job responsibilities

Create solutions that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services
Interface with internal and external customers, including developers and team leads
Gather effective feedback from customers, distill and translate feedback into clear business and technical requirements for product and engineering teams

A day in the life

As Part Of Your Internship, You May

Engage directly on actual business challenges
Gain hands-on experience building on the AWS cloud
Apply AWS services and architectural best practices in real-world scenarios
Develop technical and business acumen through working backwards from actual customer problems
Work with mentors to build and implement solutions for actual business needs
Prepare for a role advising AWS's most strategic and influential customers through practical experience

About The Team

The Emerging Talent team within AWS Industries and Strategic Accounts develops the next generation of field-ready talent (Solutions Architects, Customer Solutions Managers, and sales professionals) who work with some of the largest, most influential customers across a variety of industries. We take a cohort-based approach to talent development and provide new builders the resources (education, mentorship, job shadow opportunities) to thrive in a customer-facing role.

Basic Qualifications

Work 40 hours/week minimum and commit to a 12 week internship maximum
Experience using strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
Experience with one or more of the following domains: analytics, security, storage, DevOps, application development, or machine learning
Are 18 years of age or older
Currently enrolled in a bachelors or greater degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related technical fields with a graduation date between December 2027 and September 2028
Experience with one or more of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Node.js, C#, or C++
Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning (ML), etc

Preferred Qualifications

AWS certification
Experience communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences
Experience applying established frameworks and design patterns to deliver working software through coursework, personal projects, hackathons, or previous internships

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The starting pay for this position is listed below. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits.

Dallas, TX, USA - 103,275.00 USD Annually

Company - Amazon Web Services, Inc.

note: AWS: relevant yes, 'Solutions Architect Intern, AWSI - 2027' is a 12-week internship doing customer-facing cloud architecture work. degreeOk yes, 'Currently enrolled in a bachelors or greater degree program in Computer Science ... with a graduation date between December 2027 and September 2028' admits master's and the window includes May 2028. workAuth unclear, nothing said about sponsorship or citizenship. categories solutions, 'Create solutions that address customer business problems', 'Develop skills to lead customer engagements as a Solutions Architect'; also infra, 'helping customers build infrastructures and applications at scale using AWS solutions', and ai, 'Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning (ML)' - both are products advised on rather than built, so neither is required.
